overview: LAMER introduces a Meta-RL framework for LLM agents that trains across multi-episode trials with cross-episode credit assignment and in-context self-reflection adaptation, enabling active exploration and rapid test-time adaptation on long-horizon interactive tasks.

modules.name: Unified Environment Interface
modules.description: Wraps all four task environments (Sokoban, MineSweeper, Webshop, ALFWorld) into a common gym-style API providing step, reset, and termination signals, with support for task difficulty parameterization (e.g., number of boxes/mines) for generalization experiments.

modules.name: Prompt Template & Data Pipeline
modules.description: Constructs environment-specific standard prompts and reflection prompts with placeholder substitution (past experience reflection, history actions, observations), handling tokenization and context window management for the LLM agent's textual observation-action loop.

modules.name: Inter-Episode Memory Manager
modules.description: Manages the inter-episode memory H(n) that accumulates trajectories and/or reflections across episodes within a trial, supporting configurable content modes (trajectory-only, reflection-only, or both) and context length budgeting to maintain efficient prompt construction.

modules.name: Self-Reflection Generator
modules.description: Implements the in-context policy adaptation mechanism that prompts the LLM agent to generate textual reflections on completed episodes, identifying mistakes and devising improved plans, outputting structured reflections within designated tags for memory integration.

modules.name: Cross-Episode Rollout Engine
modules.description: Orchestrates sequential multi-episode rollout within a single trial, where each episode conditions on accumulated memory H(n), terminates upon success or step limit, and triggers the reflection generator between episodes, producing the full trial tuple T = (τ(0),...,τ(N-1)).

modules.name: Meta-RL Reward Computation
modules.description: Computes the cross-episode discounted return G(n)_t combining within-episode returns with future episode returns weighted by the trajectory discount factor γ_traj, enabling credit assignment across episodes to incentivize early exploration for later exploitation.

modules.name: Advantage Estimation for Meta-RL
modules.description: Derives advantage estimates A(n)_t from the cross-episode returns G(n)_t for use in policy gradient updates, supporting group-based baselines (as in GiGPO/GRPO) that compute advantages relative to other episodes within the same task group.

modules.name: Policy Gradient Optimizer
modules.description: Implements the Meta-RL policy gradient objective with standard algorithms (GiGPO, GRPO, PPO), computing the gradient estimator using log-probabilities of actions conditioned on state and inter-episode memory, supporting configurable group sizes and optimization hyperparameters.

modules.name: Trajectory Sampling & Group Manager
modules.description: Handles the sampling strategy where Meta-RL uses N episodes per trial with a specified group size per task, ensuring total trajectory count matches RL baselines (e.g., N=3 × group=8 vs RL group=24) for fair compute budget comparison, and managing parallel vs sequential rollout constraints.

modules.name: Meta-RL Training Loop Controller
modules.description: Orchestrates the complete training workflow including epoch management, batch iteration over tasks, cross-episode rollout generation, reward computation, advantage estimation, gradient updates, and early stopping, with support for mixed-precision training and gradient accumulation.

modules.name: Pass@k Evaluation Engine
modules.description: Evaluates trained agents using pass@k metrics (k=1,2,3) where each attempt may consist of a multi-episode trial with reflection adaptation, computing success rates across multiple sampled attempts per task to measure test-time scaling behavior.

modules.name: Trajectory Diversity Analyzer
modules.description: Quantifies exploration behavior by sampling multiple trajectories per task, grouping identical state-action sequences into an empirical distribution, computing its entropy as a diversity metric, and generating visualization plots comparing base model, RL, and Meta-RL agents.

modules.name: Generalization Test Suite
modules.description: Implements evaluation protocols for harder-task generalization (varying difficulty parameters like box/mine counts) and out-of-distribution generalization (testing on unseen task categories like Cool/Pick2 in ALFWorld), computing performance gaps between RL and Meta-RL trained models.

modules.name: Ablation Experiment Framework
modules.description: Provides controlled experiment runners for key ablations: (1) trajectory discount factor γ_traj sweep across multiple values, (2) inter-episode memory content configuration (trajectory-only, reflection-only, both), and (3) training budget analysis comparing RL and Meta-RL under matched trajectory counts.

modules.name: Configuration & Experiment Management
modules.description: Manages hierarchical experiment configurations (environment, model, training, evaluation), logging integration with training metrics and environment rewards, checkpoint saving/loading for model persistence, and automated result aggregation for LaTeX table generation and comparison plots.
